title: A+ Core 2 Practice Exam A (Original)
exam_focus: Core 2 topics: OS, security, software troubleshooting, operational procedures
notes: Homemade original practice; not official CompTIA items. Questions shuffled. Grade at end.

questions.stem: A Linux script needs execute permission for its owner. Which command changes file permissions?
Which Linux command runs a single command with elevated (root) privileges?
A user copies a file to a different folder on the SAME NTFS volume. What usually happens to the file's NTFS permissions?

choices.B: It loses all permissions and becomes inaccessible
choices.C: It gains Full Control for Everyone
choices.D: It inherits the permissions of the destination folder

questions.stem: Print jobs are stuck in the queue and nothing prints from any app. What should the technician try first?

choices.C: Restart the Print Spooler service and clear the queue
choices.D: Replace the network cable on the server

questions.stem: While on a support call, a technician's personal phone keeps ringing. What is the most professional action?

choices.A: Put the customer on hold to check social media
choices.B: Answer it quickly while the customer waits
choices.D: Silence the phone and stay focused on the customer

questions.stem: A website shows a certificate warning in all browsers on one PC only, while other PCs load it fine. What should be checked first?

choices.B: The PC's date and time settings

questions.stem: A ticket is resolved. Which ticket entry best helps the next technician who sees a similar issue?

choices.A: A clear description of the problem, steps taken, root cause, and resolution
choices.B: The word Fixed and the close date
choices.C: A note to call the original technician
choices.D: Only the user's name and phone number

questions.stem: Which document defines what employees may and may not do with company computers and networks?
Which Windows edition feature is required to join a corporate Active Directory domain?

choices.A: Only Windows Server editions can join a domain
choices.C: Any edition with S mode enabled

questions.stem: A mobile app keeps crashing after a recent app update. What is a reasonable first step?

choices.C: Clear the app's cache or reinstall the app

questions.stem: A PC crashes after a new driver installation and cannot stay running in normal mode. Which option lets the technician boot with minimal drivers to remove it?
A company wants employees to receive only the access needed to perform their jobs. What principle is this?
A technician needs a file system on a USB drive that works on both Windows and macOS and supports files larger than 4 GB. Which is the best choice?
Which tool can be used to choose a selective startup and set Safe boot options for the next restart in Windows?
Which malware type is specifically designed to hide deep in the OS and conceal its presence from normal tools?
In the CompTIA troubleshooting methodology, what is the FIRST step?

choices.B: Establish a theory of probable cause

questions.stem: Which file extension is typically used for a Linux Bash shell script?
Which Windows command-line tool scans and repairs protected system files?
A user's browser keeps redirecting searches to an unfamiliar site and shows new toolbars. What is the most likely cause?
Which Windows command forces an immediate refresh of Group Policy settings?
WPA2-Personal typically uses which encryption method?

choices.D: No encryption, only a password prompt

questions.stem: Which file extension is used for a Windows PowerShell script?
Which Linux command shows running processes and live CPU and memory usage?
A user cannot open a file and gets an Access denied message on an NTFS folder. Other users can open it. What is the most likely cause?

choices.A: The user lacks the required NTFS permissions

questions.stem: Which Windows feature returns system files, drivers, and settings to an earlier state without deleting personal documents?

choices.C: Reset this PC with Remove everything

questions.stem: Which wireless security protocol is the most secure choice for a new home router that supports it?
Which feature encrypts individual files and folders on NTFS, tied to the user's account?
A targeted phishing email is crafted specifically for the company's CEO. What is this called?
Which Windows tool shows logs such as Application, Security, and System to help find the cause of an error?
Before opening a desktop PC case, which action best protects the components from electrostatic discharge?

choices.A: Wear an antistatic wrist strap connected to a proper ground
choices.B: Touch the components with a plastic tool first
choices.C: Work on a carpeted floor in socks
choices.D: Keep the PC plugged in and powered on

questions.stem: A user's antivirus shows it has not received definition updates in weeks. What should be done first?

choices.A: Manually update definitions and verify the update service is running
choices.B: Ignore it if the PC seems fine

questions.stem: A user receives an email claiming to be from the bank with a link to confirm account details on a lookalike website. What type of attack is this?
Which file system is most commonly used for a modern Windows system drive?
In Windows 10/11, where can you quickly disable an app from launching at sign-in?
On macOS, which feature provides automatic incremental backups to an external drive?
Which Windows tool lets a technician end a frozen application and see per-process CPU and memory usage?
After a video driver update, the screen goes black at sign-in. Which Device Manager action is the best fix once the technician gets into Safe Mode?
Which backup type copies only files changed since the last backup of ANY type, and resets the archive bit?
A server room needs protection from short power outages and voltage sags. Which device is the best fit?
A Windows PC will not boot after a failed driver install. Which Windows Recovery Environment option automatically attempts to fix boot problems?
A technician has just identified the problem by questioning the user and reviewing recent changes. What should the technician do next?

choices.A: Establish a theory of probable cause
choices.D: Establish a plan of action to resolve the problem

questions.stem: A small office wants a backup strategy that follows the 3-2-1 rule. Which plan meets it?

choices.A: Three full backups kept on the same external drive
choices.B: One copy on the server, two copies on the same NAS
choices.C: Three backups per day, two technicians, one server
choices.D: Three copies of the data, on two different media types, with one copy offsite

questions.stem: Which Linux command shows the current working directory?
Which Linux command searches for text matching a pattern inside files?
Which step comes immediately after implementing the solution in the CompTIA troubleshooting process?

choices.A: Test the theory to determine the cause
choices.C: Verify full system functionality and implement preventive measures if applicable
choices.D: Establish a theory of probable cause

questions.stem: An application worked yesterday but crashes on launch after last night's update. What is the best first recovery step?

choices.A: Uninstall the recent update or repair the application

questions.stem: A technician needs to create, extend, and format partitions on a new drive using a GUI in Windows. Which tool should be used?
A user reports that a program says a required DLL file is missing. What is the best first fix?
Which Windows command displays the IP configuration, including DNS servers and MAC address?
A shared folder grants Everyone the share permission Read. The NTFS permission for a user is Modify. What is the user's effective access over the network?
A technician must lift a heavy UPS battery unit. What is the safest technique?

choices.A: Lift with the back and arms extended
choices.B: Twist the torso while lifting to save time
choices.C: Lift with the legs, keep the back straight, and get help if the item is too heavy
choices.D: Bend at the waist and lift quickly

questions.stem: Which Windows utility removes temporary files and other unneeded data to free disk space?
A user reports frequent pop-ups even with the browser closed. What is the most likely cause?
Before donating old hard drives, a company must ensure data cannot be recovered but wants the drives reusable. What is the best method?

choices.A: Use a secure overwrite/drive wipe tool
choices.D: Delete the files and empty the Recycle Bin

questions.stem: A Windows 11 PC boots very slowly. Many apps load at sign-in. What is the best first step?
An administrator wants to upgrade the firewall firmware on a production network. Under change management, what should happen first?

choices.A: Ask one user if the time is convenient
choices.B: Install the firmware immediately during business hours
choices.C: Submit a change request with scope, risk, and a rollback plan for approval
choices.D: Upgrade first and document it later if problems occur

questions.stem: An enterprise wants each Wi-Fi user to authenticate with their own domain credentials through a RADIUS server. Which mode should be used?
Which is the LAST step in the CompTIA malware removal process?
A technician tests a theory and it is NOT confirmed. What should the technician do?

choices.B: Establish a new theory or escalate

questions.stem: Which Windows share permission lets users read, create, modify, and delete files but NOT change permissions?
Which Windows tool is used to roll back, update, or disable a device driver?
A user's PC shows malware symptoms. According to the CompTIA malware removal process, what is the FIRST step?

choices.A: Enable System Restore and create a restore point
choices.B: Investigate and verify the malware symptoms

questions.stem: A company wants full-disk encryption on Windows laptops that uses the TPM to protect the key. Which feature should be used?

choices.D: EFS on a single file only

questions.stem: A phishing attempt is delivered by SMS text message. What is it called?
On macOS, which tool is used to repair, erase, and partition drives?
Which malware type spreads across networks by itself without needing a user to run a file?
Which file extension is used for a Windows batch file run by cmd.exe?
Malware is confirmed on a workstation. After quarantining the system, what should be done BEFORE remediating in Windows?

choices.B: Re-enable System Restore and create a restore point
choices.D: Reconnect the system to the network

questions.stem: A Windows PC has become very slow. Task Manager shows one process using 100% CPU. What should the technician do first?

choices.C: Identify the process and end or troubleshoot it

questions.stem: An application freezes and shows Not Responding. What should a user try first?

choices.A: End the task in Task Manager and reopen the app
choices.D: Unplug the PC from the wall

questions.stem: A dialog dims the screen and asks for approval before an installer makes system-level changes in Windows. What feature is this?
Which step comes immediately after the theory is confirmed in the CompTIA troubleshooting process?

choices.A: Question the user about recent changes
choices.B: Document findings and close the ticket
choices.D: Establish a plan of action to resolve the problem and implement the solution

questions.stem: A Windows Update fails repeatedly with the same error. What should the technician check first?

choices.D: Run the Windows Update troubleshooter and check free disk space

questions.stem: Which Windows command checks a volume for file system errors and bad sectors?
Where should a technician look for handling, storage, and disposal information for a toner or cleaning chemical?
A desktop app is slow and the drive light stays on constantly. Task Manager shows disk usage at 100%. What is a good first step?

choices.D: Identify which process is causing the disk activity in Task Manager or Resource Monitor

questions.stem: Several users report the same internal web app error since this morning, but other sites work. What is the best next step?

choices.A: Tell users to stop using the app forever
choices.D: Check whether a recent change was made to the web app or its server

questions.stem: Someone stands behind an employee in a coffee shop to watch them type a password. Which attack is this?
A browser loads pages slowly and shows outdated content on one site. What is a quick fix to try?

choices.D: Clear the browser cache and cookies

questions.stem: Which Windows tool provides real-time and logged graphs of performance counters for long-term analysis?
How should old lithium-ion laptop batteries be disposed of?

choices.B: Through a recycling program or facility that follows local regulations
choices.C: By burning them in a safe outdoor area
choices.D: By puncturing them to drain the charge first

questions.stem: A technician finds a spreadsheet of customer Social Security numbers saved on a shared desktop. What type of data is this?
An attacker follows an employee through a badge-secured door without scanning a badge. What is this called?
A user downloads a free game that also secretly installs a backdoor. What type of malware best describes this?
A user's Windows profile fails to load and they get a temporary profile at sign-in. What is a likely cause?
Which login method is an example of multifactor authentication?

choices.B: A password plus a one-time code from an authenticator app
choices.C: A password and a security question

questions.stem: Files on a workstation are suddenly encrypted and a message demands payment in cryptocurrency. What type of malware is this?
A Windows PC shows a Blue Screen of Death after a new RAM module was installed. What should be checked first?

choices.C: Reseat or test the new RAM module

questions.stem: A Windows PC randomly reboots. Event Viewer shows a Kernel-Power critical error. What is a reasonable area to investigate?

choices.B: Power supply, overheating, or unexpected power loss

questions.stem: A customer is upset and talking over the technician. What should the technician do first?

choices.A: Listen actively without interrupting, then restate the problem to confirm understanding
choices.B: Argue the point until the customer agrees
choices.D: Use technical jargon to show expertise
